lines.text: Near the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples to a village to find a colt tied there.
Jesus told them to answer anyone who asked by saying the Lord needs it and will return it tomorrow.
The disciples found the colt tied at a doorway, untied it, and brought it to Jesus, who sat on it.
Many in the crowd spread cloaks and grain on the road and blessed the coming kingdom of their father David.
Jesus entered the temple courts, looked around at everything, and since it was late, went to Bethany with the Twelve.
